items.name: Farm Sanctuary Southern California
items.description: National farm animal protection nonprofit whose Southern California shelter in Acton houses about 100 rescued farm animals and runs guided tours Friday through Sunday.

items.name: The Gentle Barn
items.description: Santa Clarita sanctuary for rescued cows, horses, pigs, goats and birds that opens to the public on Sundays and pairs animal care with programs for youth.

items.name: Kindred Spirits Care Farm
items.description: Chatsworth care farm that combines a rescued-animal sanctuary with garden, volunteer and education programs and posts ranch open hours on its site.

items.name: Saving Grace Animal Sanctuary
items.description: Acton farm animal sanctuary caring for about 30 rescued cows, donkeys, horses, pigs, sheep, goats and birds, visited by appointment with a day's notice.

items.name: Sale Ranch Animal Sanctuary
items.description: Off-grid farmed animal rescue in Temecula that runs private tours, ticketed public events, an annual gala and a regenerative garden volunteer program.

items.name: Farm Animal Refuge
items.description: San Diego County backcountry refuge near Campo for abused and slaughter-bound farm animals, offering private tours, open houses, free field trips and a volunteer program.

items.name: Farmstrong Rescue
items.description: Redlands nonprofit founded in 2025 that shelters abandoned farm animals and runs field trips, a youth program, a seasonal pumpkin patch and volunteer days.

items.name: Shambala Preserve (Roar Foundation)
items.description: Big cat preserve in Acton, home to more than 50 rescued lions, tigers, leopards and other exotic cats, visited on reserved monthly safaris for adults.

items.name: Lions Tigers & Bears
items.description: Exotic animal sanctuary in Alpine housing more than 60 rescued animals across 19 species, including big cats, bears and ranch animals, open by reservation Wednesday through Saturday.

items.name: STAR Eco Station
items.description: Culver City environmental science museum and rescue center for confiscated exotic wildlife, with hourly weekend public tours and a volunteer program for ages 14 and up.

items.name: Pacific Marine Mammal Center
items.description: Laguna Beach hospital for stranded sea lions, elephant seals, harbor seals and fur seals that rehabilitates and releases its patients with the help of animal care and education volunteers.

items.name: Marine Mammal Care Center Los Angeles
items.description: San Pedro rehabilitation hospital for stranded sea lions and seals, open to visitors Friday through Monday with docent-led viewing.

items.name: Pebble Ranch Rescue
items.description: Lakeside nonprofit that rescues, rehabilitates and rehomes pot-bellied pigs and lists volunteer opportunities on its site.

items.name: The Open Barn
items.description: Ramona farm animal sanctuary founded in 2020 that asks volunteers for a recurring commitment and hosts fundraising events on site; its street address is not published.

items.name: New Life Animal Sanctuary
items.description: Volunteer-run Lake Elsinore sanctuary for pigs, cows, goats, sheep, birds and small animals; visits are arranged by email and volunteers commit to weekly four-hour shifts.

items.name: Viva Rescue
items.description: Menifee nonprofit sanctuary for goats, chickens, horses and other rescued animals that offers private tours by donation and takes volunteer applications.

items.name: Kaleidoscope Desert Sanctuary
items.description: Morongo Valley nonprofit where more than a hundred rescued animals roam among outdoor art; adults-only guided tours and day passes fund the rescue, and the address is shared on booking.

items.name: Anonymous for the Voiceless
items.description: International street outreach organization whose Cube of Truth chapter directory lists Los Angeles, Orange County and San Diego groups.

items.name: Mercy For Animals
items.description: Farmed animal protection nonprofit headquartered on Sunset Boulevard in Los Angeles that runs investigations, corporate campaigns and public events.

items.name: Last Chance for Animals
items.description: Los Angeles animal rights nonprofit known for undercover investigations and campaigns against animal testing, the pet trade and the dog meat trade.

items.name: Beagle Freedom Project
items.description: Valley Village nonprofit that rescues animals from laboratories and campaigns to end animal testing.

items.name: Social Compassion in Legislation
items.description: California nonprofit, run from Orange County, that sponsors and lobbies for state animal protection bills.

items.name: SoCal VegFest
items.description: Annual Orange County vegan festival held at the OC Fair and Event Center in Costa Mesa.

items.name: Vegan Street Fair
items.description: Los Angeles based producer of free-entry vegan food festivals, including its Los Angeles street fair, that also runs events in other cities.

items.name: Animal Protection and Rescue League
items.description: Volunteer-run animal rights nonprofit based in San Diego and Orange counties.

items.name: Vegan in San Diego
items.description: San Diego County nonprofit dedicated to making veganism more accessible that publishes local vegan event listings and runs a recurring night market.
